hypothesis: A positive monthly change in point-in-time-conservative FINRA customer margin leverage can identify frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events that are too early, improving return while matching or exceeding V11 Sharpe and beating an availability-matched unconditional U.S.-retention control.
allowed_changes: F-MARGIN-LEV-US exact FINRA MarginLeverage = Debit / (CashFreeCredit + MarginFreeCredit)
risk-on exactly when current unified-month MarginLeverage minus immediately previous unified-month MarginLeverage is positive
on factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events, retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions when risk-on
selection_metric: No within-family model selection. Compare the single candidate against frozen V11 and C-MARGIN-LEV-ALWAYS, then apply every preregistered deterministic, bootstrap and cumulative DSR gate.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260821
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate and no within-family selection
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using prior 26 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-MARGIN-LEV-US, total trial count 27
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This FINRA-margin campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not search debit-only, alternate free-credit denominators, market-cap/CPI/GDP normalization, multi-month changes, moving averages, z-scores, percentiles, level or magnitude thresholds, sign reversals, retention fractions, stale rules, publication lags, or a second retrospective margin-debt family. A promising non-robust result may only become a new prospective shadow from a new freeze date.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_finra_margin_leverage_v1.py -> tools/finra_margin_leverage_v1.swiftpart + tools/finra_margin_leverage_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/U.S.-de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.source: FINRA Margin Statistics official rolling XLSX
factor_definition.leverage_rule: Debit Balances / (Free Credit Balances in Cash Accounts + Free Credit Balances in Securities Margin Accounts)
factor_definition.delta_rule: current reference-month leverage ratio minus immediately previous reference-month leverage ratio

availability_policy.finra_statement: statistics generally published in the third week of the month following the reference month
availability_policy.conservative_rule: reference month usable only on first calendar day of the second following month
availability_policy.reason: intentionally later than FINRA's normal publication window so no exact historical release timestamps are required

matched_control.rule: retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions on every factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-de-risk event regardless of the sign of DeltaMarginLeverage

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligible_event: current frozen V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 versus prior frozen V11 event target

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any debit-only or free-credit-only rescue factor
any alternate denominator or market-cap, CPI, GDP or equity-price normalization
any 2/3/6/12-month or other multi-month change or moving average
any z-score, percentile, level threshold, magnitude threshold, persistence rule or sign reversal
any change to 35-day stale rule or conservative publication lag
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective FINRA margin factor after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting
